clips.title: The story
paras: Camping 101: Cooking is an introductory quest that instructs adventurers on how basic culinary knowledge forms the foundation of establishing a campsite in the wilderness. By seeking out Pyall Silentstride in Bloodhoof Village, travelers learn to build a campfire to anchor their camp and prepare for life on the frontier.

Every long journey through the untamed wilds demands basic wilderness survival, and every true camp begins with fire. For wanderers stepping across Kalimdor, the quest Camping 101: Cooking introduces the essential relationship between culinary training and frontier survival. Cooking is not merely about preparing nourishing meals from hunted game; it provides the fundamental knowledge needed to build a working campfire out in the elements. Without a fire, an adventurer has no camp to return to when night falls.

In the rolling plains of Mulgore, adventurers are directed to Pyall Silentstride in Bloodhoof Village to learn the basics of cooking. With this foundational training, an adventurer gains the ability to strike a campfire anywhere in the wilderness and pitch a basic camp. While initial camps are simple and allow few furnishings, advancing one's cooking proficiency unlocks the secrets of kindling larger fires. In turn, craftsmen versed in other trades can craft furnishings to flesh out their frontier outposts.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, adventurer. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.
Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

clips.title: Completion
paras: With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.
Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.
You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
